q1_issues.issue: (Possession jirsa marshall) reads as Jirsa being possessed by Marshall; Possession is licensed for 's, a possessive pronoun or a possessive of-phrase, and "Marshall head coach" is bare noun-noun juxtaposition with no genitive marker.

The sealed Theme term also carries definitional/typing atoms (Inheritance head_coach coach, Inheritance news_conference conference, Member cam_henderson_center center, Member bob_hartley_big_green_room room, LocatedIn ...), which are not part of the reported proposition — the factive pattern seals P's predications and projects typing atoms at top level.
The "as Marshall head coach" predicative is asserted as a flat (Member jirsa head_coach) with no link to the introduce event, so the parse loses that the role is what he is being introduced AS.

q2_gaps: predicative "as"-complement ("is being introduced AS Marshall head coach", "appointed as chair") — no licensed encoding for a secondary predicate introduced by "as"; Resultatives covers only bare state/motion results

a proper-noun modifier naming an AFFILIATION on a common-noun head ("Marshall head coach", "Google engineer") — Compound concepts explicitly excludes proper nouns from fusion and supplies no relation for the affiliation
a postposed evidential/reporting tail (", The Herald-Dispatch learned") — Propositional attitudes specifies only a fronted attitude verb with a following that-complement
notes: The factive dual-emit (sealed Theme plus the same atoms at top level) is executed consistently, and noon -> (Hour 12), the name symbols and the room/center containment all follow the instruction set. One instruction-set tension surfaced here: Thematic roles lists "learn" among the progressive-accepting event verbs that take Agent, while Propositional attitudes prescribes Experiencer for the factive list that includes learn — the parse followed the latter.
